headline: Binance Intake Rises To 123.4 Million Dollars As Net Venue Inflow Falls To 412.5 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, shows Binance took in 123.4 million dollars, compared with 41.9 million dollars on the prior print. Net inflow across venues is 412.5 million dollars, 0.1531 percent of custodied value, compared with 514.8 million dollars at 0.1909 percent on the prior print. A positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell, and a negative print means dollars left that venue.
author: jordan
